pages.text: $(thing)Cataclysm x Create Integration$() is a data pack. It replaces Cataclysm's gear recipes with Create ones, so boss loot gets turned into equipment by machines instead of at a normal crafting table.

About 35 items are made by $(thing)Sequenced Assembly$(): a base item goes through Deployer, Press, Deployer steps with boss materials. A few use Mechanical Crafting. Weapons, armor, shields, smithing templates and summoning Eyes are covered.

pages.title: Mechanical Fusion Anvil
pages.text: Made from an Anvil with Sturdy Sheets, Precision Mechanisms and Redstone Blocks.

pages.title: Example: The Incinerator
pages.text: Starts as a Netherite sword. Check JEI for its Sequenced Assembly.

pages.title: Laser Gatling
pages.text: Starts as a crossbow, uses electron tubes and redstone blocks.

It also adds crushing recipes that recycle Cataclysm gear: black steel tools, Cursium, Ignitium and more go into a Crushing Wheel for nuggets, some ingots and XP nuggets. Read $(l:create_basics/crushing)Crushing$(/l) and $(l:create_basics/brass_and_assembly)Assembly$(/l).

The Abyssal Sacrifice, a Cataclysm ritual item, is now a compacting recipe that needs a heated Basin, so a Blaze Burner. See $(l:create_basics/heat)Heat$(/l). Links: $(l:exploration/cataclysm)Cataclysm$(/l).
